title: Associate - Content (Digest)
jobDescription: <div><strong>About Groww:</strong></div> <div>We are a passionate group of people focused on making financial services accessible to every Indian through a multi-product platform. It fosters an environment where collaboration, transparency, and open communication take center-stage and hierarchies fade away. There is space for every individual to be themselves and feel motivated to bring their best to the table, as well as craft a promising career for themselves.</div> <div>The values that form our foundation are:</div> <ul> <li>Radical customer centricity</li> <li>Ownership-driven culture</li> <li>Keeping everything simple</li> <li>Long-term thinking</li> <li>Complete transparency</li> </ul> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><strong>About the Role</strong></div> <div>We’re looking for a copy intern who’s curious about finance, words, people, and how simple language can make intimidating topics feel easy. This role is for someone who wants to learn by doing, writing copy that goes out to millions of users. You’ll work closely with designers, marketers, and product teams to bring ideas to life across campaigns, in-app experiences, and everyday user communication. If you enjoy playing with words, thinking from a user’s point of view, and believe that great copy is clear, warm, and intentional, you’ll feel right at home.</div> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work closely with designers and copywriters to craft clear, simple, and engaging copy across campaigns, in-app events, and brand communications.</li> <li>Write short-form copy like headlines, subheads, CTAs, captions, and microcopy that feels friendly and easy to understand</li> <li>Help simplify financial ideas using everyday language, without making them feel boring or overwhelming</li> <li>Explore different tones and formats while staying aligned with Groww’s brand voice</li> <li>Learn how copy works alongside visuals, layouts, and user journeys to create meaningful experiences</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Currently pursuing or recently graduated in English, Mass Communication, Marketing, or a related field</li> <li>Strong interest in writing both long &amp; short form formats and storytelling (college work, personal projects, blogs, or social content all count)</li> <li>Ability to write clearly and concisely, especially short, punchy copy</li> <li>Basic understanding of branding and tone of voice</li> <li>Comfortable collaborating with designers and other team members</li> <li>Interest in finance, fintech, or personal money concepts is a plus (but not mandatory)</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll gain</strong></p> <p>Hands-on experience writing user-facing copy with guidance from experienced writers and designers. You’ll learn how ideas move from brief to final execution, understand how copy impacts user behaviour, and build a strong foundation in brand &amp; product communication.</p> <p><strong>Duration:</strong> 6 months<br><strong>Location:</strong> on-site</p>

title: Equity Research Analyst (AMC)

experienceProfile.rawText: <p><strong>About Us: Groww Mutual Fund</strong></p> <p><strong>Who We Are:</strong></p> <p>Groww Mutual Fund, previously known as Indiabulls Mutual Fund, offers mutual fund schemes designed to suit the various needs and objectives of its investors. We are anchored by principles of simplicity, transparency, long-term wealth creation, and unwavering focus on our customers. Our fund takes pride in identifying investment avenues that combine promising growth potential with solid fundamentals.</p> <p>With the robust backing of Groww Invest-Tech Private Limited (formerly known as Nextbillion Technology Private Limited), our portfolio brims with a diverse range of schemes, from equity funds and hybrid funds to debt funds.</p> <p><strong>Our Mission:</strong></p> <p>Our foremost mission is to create steady, long-term wealth for our investors. We are relentlessly dedicated to unearthing promising opportunities and meticulously designing innovative schemes that enable our investors to harness these wealth-building potentials.</p> <p><strong>What We Stand For:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Simplicity and Transparency: We ensure our communication about the fundʼs performance, strategy, goals, and challenges is jargon-free. Our commitment is 100% clarity, empowering investors to make informed decisions.</li> <li>Focus on Consistent Wealth Creation: Consistency over intensity. Our precision lies in selecting securities that consistently compound returns, paving the way for investors to realize their financial aspirations.</li> <li>Customer Centricity: From tailored products that align with your financial objectives, to resources that inform your decisions, to the unwavering support that underscores our care - you remain the cornerstone of our endeavors.</li> <li>Innovation at the Forefront: We constantly strive to redefine the landscape of wealth management through our innovative schemes, catering to varying risk levels, time horizons, and liquidity scales.</li> </ul> <p>Our team is a tapestry of passion, commitment, and innovation. Every member of the Groww Mutual Fund family is instilled with a sense of ownership, a customer-first mindset, unwavering integrity, and a thirst to challenge the established norms.</p> <p>If you're inspired by the idea of redefining conventions and making a lasting impact, you might just be the addition we're seeking.</p> <p>Together, let's shape the future of wealth management in India.</p> <p><strong>About the ROLE: </strong></p> <p>In this role, you will provide objective investment research to the fund management team and help them make informed investment decisions. Candidates should have a solid foundation in BFSI sector as well as analytical skills to understand emerging trends and sectors. Effective team members with high ethical integrity are a must, and candidates with the ability to scale up their skill set to become future fund managers are preferred.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Create and maintain earnings, valuation, and industrial models for the BFSI Sector.</li> <li>Analyze data to identify emerging opportunities and risks.</li> <li>Identify actionable investment ideas. Help the team to create alpha by providing timely buy/sell recommendations.</li> <li>Maintain proper documentation and constant coverage of industry-related news, trends, and developments. Disseminate your&nbsp;insight to the team on a timely basis.</li> <li>Devise and perform your primary research methods, keeping abreast of trends and sentiment in their sectors and markets.</li> <li>Should be an executioner, team player, and self-starter.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Expertise and Qualification</strong></p> <ul> <li>Masterʼs degree in finance, economics/ CA.</li> <li>2-5 years of relevant experience.</li> <li>In-depth understanding of sectors covered. In addition, a deep understanding of fundamental analysis, financial modeling, and valuation.</li> <li>CA/FRM/CFA/MBA is a plus.</li> </ul>

title: Graphic Designer - Intern

Each day, we help millions of customers take charge of their financial journey. Customer obsession is in our DNA. Every product, every design, every algorithm down to the tiniest detail is executed keeping the customers’ needs and convenience in mind. Our people are our greatest strength. Let’s chat.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><strong>Our Vision</strong></div> <div>Every individual deserves the knowledge, tools, and confidence to make informed financial decisions. At Groww, we are making sure every Indian feels empowered to do so through a cutting-edge multi-product platform offering a variety of financial services. Our long-term vision is to become the trusted financial partner for millions of Indians.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><strong>Our Values&nbsp;</strong></div> <div>Our culture enables us to be what we are — India’s fastest-growing financial services company. It fosters an environment where collaboration, transparency, and open communication take center-stage and hierarchies fade away. There is space for every individual to be themselves and feel motivated to bring their best to the table, as well as craft a promising career for themselves.</div> <div>The values that form our foundation are:</div> <ul> <li>Radical customer centricity</li> <li>Ownership-driven culture</li> <li>Keeping everything simple</li> <li>Long-term thinking</li> <li>Complete transparency</li> </ul> <div><strong>About the Role</strong></div> <p>We’re looking for a design intern who’s curious, hands-on, and excited to actually make things. You’re not just going to watch from the sidelines but actually work on real projects, and see it live with millions of users. If you enjoy thinking through ideas, and believe good design is as much about the words as the visuals, you’ll fit right in.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>Work closely with our design team to shape experiences that feel simple, clear, and genuinely helpful for our users. We’re looking for someone who likes to explore, try things out, and isn’t afraid to experiment. You’ll be thinking through layouts, visuals, and hierarchy, and using words to make ideas land clearly. From campaign creatives and in-app moments to small bits of microcopy, you’ll explore how design and language work together, experiment with different approaches, and learn what helps financial ideas feel simple and inviting.</p> <p><strong>Required Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Currently studying design or recently graduated</li> <li>A portfolio that shows how you think, including college work, personal projects,<br>or freelance work</li> <li>Strong sense of visual craft with a good eye for layout, hierarchy, and composition</li> <li>Understands how words and visuals work together to make ideas clearer</li> <li>Comfortable using tools like Figma or Adobe</li> <li>Curious about fintech and interested in making finance feel simple and accessible is a bonus</li> <li>Open to feedback and willing to iterate on your work</li> <li>Communicates clearly and enjoys collaborating with others</li> <li>Curious, proactive, and eager to grow</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll gain</strong></p> <p>Hands-on experience working on real projects, along with guidance and feedback from experienced designers and writers. You’ll get a behind-the-scenes look at how ideas go from concept to launch.<br><br><strong>Duration:</strong> 6 months<br><strong>Location:</strong> on-site</p>
